name: idc-cmmd
description: This collection contains clinical data and 3,728 mammographies (MG) from 1,775 patients, with biopsy-confirmed benign or malignant breast tumors. For a subset of 749 patients (D2-####), molecular subtype is included. Please see the CMMD wiki page for further detail and associated metadata.

recordSet.name: Clinical variables with measured completeness
recordSet.description: Completeness is measured from the source repository's own records. A field populated entirely with non-answers is reported as populated but not informative, because it blocks an analysis just as surely as an absent field.
